{{Conjecture|legends}}
A '''faction''' of [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] and [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] opposed a [[Jedi faction (Doomed)|band]] of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] after both groups crash-landed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]] after [[6900 BBY]]. The opposing groups caused untold destruction to the world and its native inhabitants, the [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]]. Realizing the consequences of their actions&mdash;a period later referred to as the [[Great Calamity]]&mdash;the members agreed to a truce. One member of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] faction refused, however: the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Remulus Dreypa]]. His fellow dark siders thus locked him in an [[Oubliette (stasis casket)|oubliette]]. The two sided merged forces to form [[the Doomed]], moving to the polar continent [[Eshkrene]] to watch over the Keshiri.
